GAP_ANALYSIS_AC_AMENDMENT (3/5): Error-path contract for downstream touchpoints

Amend AC to add:
- Writer exits with documented non-zero codes for: schema-validation-failure, lock-acquisition-timeout, migration-failure, artifact-not-found, JSON-parse-failure
- stderr emits exactly one machine-parseable line per failure: APPEND_REVIEW_CYCLE_ERROR: code=<name> path=<artifact> detail=<...>
- On any failure, artifact is unchanged on disk (atomic write guarantee)
- Tests cover at least: artifact-not-found (non-existent path), JSON-parse-failure (corrupted artifact), invalid verdict enum

taxonomy: missing_error_path
